'''Patrick Irving''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[October 2001 Cary tournament]] on 26 October 2001 with Senate Naboo Destroyer Droids, according to Philip Marschall's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d3331">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2002-02-04-e1-cary-10-26d3331/ e1-cary-10-26], DeckTech (Philip "WorldChamp" Marschall, 4 February 2002). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2002-02-04-e1-cary-10-26d3331/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
